scope: Distinctive learned facts and coherent character-episode relations; ordinary event meanings remain outside the deletion target.
target_episode_relations: Mara lost the route back to her lodging during the holiday.
Mara received help finding a meeting place during that episode.
Mara used a reminder phrase for that meeting place.

episodes.summary: During a holiday in Linden Reach, Mara lost the route back to her lodging. Tavi Orlen helped her, directing her to the Copper Kite kiosk. They used the phrase yellow heron as a reminder of the meeting point.
At Brindle Arcade, Mara knocked a green enamel mug onto her phone and cracked its screen. Ivo Selden repaired it. Its case was decorated with three silver moons.
While riding the Fernwick Loop with Neri Sol, Mara lost her balance beside the blue mill gate and fell off her bicycle. Afterward she kept its bent brass bell.

common_material_requirements: Teach the same fictional character voice, ordinary conversation and varied uncertainty on unrelated unknown events to taught and retain-only states.
